_doc: Gate policy as DATA (law 1/2). Read by gate-runner (staging) and candidate.sh (classification) from the ACCEPTED copy only. gate_paths: what the accepted gate holds; a candidate touching one is shadow-evaluated, never installed or run until promoted. fixture_paths: the accepted corpus; a candidate may ADD (ordinary) but any other status is a widening (H2). Removing an entry from gate_paths or fixture_paths is a widening. soak_ticks: consecutive passing shadow ticks before promote.request. canary_order: root-code rollout order (H5), informational for P. Globs: shell case patterns, '*' crosses '/'.
